summary: When setting up an account, failure to connect to a port because of a certificate error is not reported to the console
description:
During account set up, each failed attempt to connect to a port is reported on the console, e.g.:

> test.test:110 socketType=0 pop3: [Exception... "Connection to test.test:110 failed"  nsresult: "0x804b000d (NS_ERROR_CONNECTION_REFUSED)"  location: "JS frame :: resource:///modules/accountcreation/GuessConfig.sys.mjs :: onStopRequest :: line 1247"  data: no]

but this isn't true where an attempt fails because of a TLS certificate error. In that case, we *do* [suggest the user can change a pref and ignore the bad certificate](https://searchfox.org/comm-central/rev/5e8e75f9c60ffee9c773850f1e31f5878df3f92b/mail/components/accountcreation/modules/GuessConfig.sys.mjs#1224-1226) but that's only an info-level message and not shown with the default log level setting. There should be an exception thrown at this point so that the error handler reports the failure.
